item.title: Who By His Own Hand Book Launch — Tue Oct 20, 5:00 PM — Ben McNally Books
item.description: [at Ben McNally Books] Join us at Ben McNally Books, in partnership with Cormorant Books, as we celebrate the launches of Who By His Own Hand by Greg Rhyno. Order the book here. Greg will be in conversation with Kerry Clare, author of Definitely Thriving. About the Book: Single mother and reluctant detective Dame Polara just wants to keep her family safe. When her two-year-old daughter is kidnapped by an old enemy, she must draw on her unusual talents to rescue Rosie. To make matters worse, Dame’s dad — retired private eye Dodge Polara — is hospitalized after suffering a second stroke. Soon after, Dame uncovers a startling connection between her mother’s decades-old murder and the apparent suicide of a former city councillor. Scouring the Greater Toronto Area in search of Rosie, Dame calls on her friends, her father’s shady connections, and even her former adversaries for aid. item.title: Civic Meetup #565: Measuring Main Streets: Data Tools for Transit-Oriented Communities - by Civic Tech Toronto — Tue Oct 20, 7:00 PM — Hybrid: Online & address available to attendees
item.description:
More info: https://guild.host/events/civic-meetup-565-measuring-o41goa
Hosted by Civic Tech Toronto (https://civictech.ca/)
Understanding what communities need from housing and transit, and deploying evidence-based responses to those needs is hard. To equip community leaders with needed tools, the Canadian Urban Institute (CUI) developed Measuring Main Streets. We'll demo the platform's tools and show how they go beyond traditional transit-oriented development.

item.description:
Address: Check event page for more details.
This is a private screening of Intelligence Rising, a documentary selected for South by Southwest (SXSW) London and CPH:DOX, the Copenhagen documentary festival. The film follows an AI strategy wargame directed by i3 Gen, initiated by Marc Warner of Faculty.ai, with design input from Technology Strategy Roleplay (TSR). It brought together Stan McChrystal, Yuval Noah Harari, Stuart Russell, Pippa Malmgren, Lord Nicholas Fairfax, Mark Sedwill, Stephen Hsu and others to play out how artificial intelligence could reshape society. The documentary was directed by Elena Andreicheva of Nice…

item.title: Continental Philosophy Research Group (Thimo Heisenberg, Rice University) — Thu Nov 5, 3:00 PM — Jackman Humanities Building
item.description: The Continental Philosophy Research Interest Group welcomes guest speaker Thimo Heisenberg, an associate professor in the Department of Philosophy at Rice University. Professor Heisenberg is a specialist in 19th and 20th century German Philosophy. Having earned his PhD from Columbia in 2019, his work has appeared in journals such as the British Journal of the History of Philosophy, the European Journal of Philosophy, Inquiry, and the Journal of the American Philosophical Association, as well as in many edited collections and anthologies. He was a Fulbright Scholar, and has received fellowships from the Alexander-von-Humboldt Foundation, the German National Academic Foundation, the Max Weber Program and from Columbia University. His book, The Economy in German Idealism, is under contract with Oxford University Press. The Canadian drama film, Doubles, set in both Trinidad and Toronto, explores the relationship between a son and his estranged father. When tragedy strikes, Dhani, a Doubles stand operator dreaming of owning his own restaurant, must leave Trinidad to find his father, whom he hasn't seen in years. Their reunion brings deeply held feelings to the surface as unexpected revelations change their lives forever.
